data.title: list_projects — discover registered projects from mounts.json
data.summary: MCP tool _list_projects() — zero parameters. Reads ~/docs-server/mounts.json, checks has_index for each. Returns {projects: [{project, path, has_index}]}.

sections.body: Add _list_projects() -> dict[str, Any] to reckon/mcp.py. Resolve mounts_file = Path.home() / 'docs-server' / 'mounts.json'. If not exists return {projects: []}. Parse mounts, sort by name. For each name/path, check has_index = (state_root / name / 'index.json').is_file(). No Pydantic model needed (zero params). Register with mcp.tool() at bottom of file.

In tests/test_mcp_tools.py: test_list_projects_with_mounts (writes a synthetic mounts.json to tmp_path/docs-server/; monkeypatches Path.home(); returns correct entries), test_list_projects_no_mounts_file (mounts.json absent → returns {projects:[]}), test_list_projects_has_index (has_index=True when index.json present in state root).
